scope: Proposition 8.1 of the manuscript “A power saving for planar halving lines” (preprints/A-power-saving-for-planar-halving-lines-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 183 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 61d7aa1ffad4b796), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that, for every η > 0, there is Rη < ∞ such that for every generic planar configuration of N points, every rank, and every integer 1 ≤ b ≤ N with N/b ≥ Rη, the number of step-disjoint intervals of activity at least b is at most η(N/b)4/3. Then there are absolute constants ε > 0 and C such that every such rank sweep has at most CN4/3−ε switches.
